name: Gaussian Asset Generation
definition: A Python script to generate a deterministic, reproducible 3D Gaussian Splatting PLY asset (a dense rainbow sphere shell) compatible with the SceneView PlyParser (P1a). It creates a synthetic test asset without randomness or external data.
summary: Gaussian Asset Generation is a deterministic method that creates a reproducible 3D Gaussian Splatting PLY asset without randomness or external data.
